Oh yaaas! Spending half a day swimming in the sea\nwas worth it!!\nWoo-hoo, yayyyy! Look, it's amazing!
All of these are Goddess Beads, right?\nWe're rich!
How could you still be so full of energy after\nconstantly swimming for almost half a day?
Well, with all these Goddess Beads right in front\nof you, it's understandable...\nUm? Wait, whaaat?!
Um, this is weird...\nThese crystals are definitely Goddess Beads,\nthere's no mistake about it, but...
They give off only a very faint scent...\nAs if the power in them has been lost...
No way, that's cruel~!\nSo almost all of these crystals are...
They're just jewels that are somewhat rare and\nhave almost no value as Goddess Beads...
Sigh...what a bummer...Bad things happen,\nI'll just take these crystals and tell people that\nthey're jewels, then sell them at a high price...
Whoaaaaa!!
Are you okay?
*huff, puff*\nI-I...I can't move anymore...
Um? There is a strong smell of Goddess Beads\nahead...It's so strong that the crystals here just\ncan't compare with them...
Oooh!\nThis time for sure it's a massive deposit of\nGoddess Beads!!
